voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: England, eighteen ninety-seven. Dora Penny received a cipher from Edward Elgar. Two years later, she became a piece of his music.
London, June eighteen ninety-nine. The first performance of his Enigma Variations. Variation ten, called Dorabella, is a portrait of her.
In the programme, Elgar said that through the whole set, another, larger theme goes, but is not played.
He told her he thought she, of all people, would guess it. She never did.
Elgar died in nineteen thirty-four without naming it. Dozens of answers have been proposed. None has ever been generally accepted.
